name: Cito UFC API
description:
Self-serve UFC data API for developers. Fighters, event cards, bout and round-by-round
statistics, divisional rankings, betting odds and live fight-night state.

**Authentication** — send your key in the `x-api-key` header.

**Getting a key** — free tier of 500 calls/month, no credit card:
https://citoapi.com/signup/

**Conventions** — responses are wrapped in a `{ data, meta }` envelope. Paginated
lists carry `meta.page`, `meta.totalPages` and `meta.hasNextPage`. Timestamps are
ISO-8601 UTC. Errors are `{ error: { code, message, request_id } }`.

**Odds** — an empty `data.markets` array is a normal coverage state for third-party
market data, not an error. Odds are for research, media and display.

**Live** — in-round state is available over REST polling and over WebSocket at
`wss://api.citoapi.com/api/v1/ufc/live/ws`. See https://citoapi.com/docs/api/ufc/

**Disclaimer** — independent API, not affiliated with, endorsed by or licensed by
the UFC, Zuffa, TKO Group Holdings or any promotion.
